scheme_name: HDFC Large Cap Fund Direct Growth

key_metrics.exit_load: 1% if redeemed within 1 year; Nil after 1 year (365 days)

parsed_sections.Investment Objective: The scheme seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation and income by investing predominantly in large-cap companies. The fund invests at least 80% of total assets in top 100 companies by market capitalization.
parsed_sections.Expense Ratio & Exit Load: Expense ratio is 1.02% (Direct Plan). Exit load is 1% if redeemed within 1 year (365 days) from allotment; Nil if redeemed after 1 year. Stamp duty is 0.005% on purchases.
parsed_sections.Minimum Investment & Liquidity: Minimum SIP investment is ₹100. Minimum Lumpsum investment is ₹100. There is no statutory lock-in period; units can be redeemed on any business day.
parsed_sections.Riskometer & Benchmark: Riskometer rating is Very High. Benchmark index is NIFTY 100 Total Return Index (TRI).
